简介_EN: Wind element condenses into solid air mass, suspended still in slim bottle, unmoved when shaken. Silver wind-patterned cap seals this time-frozen balance. Soft hiss on opening signals balance collapse, highly collectible.
icon: res://素材/豆包AI素材/药水/收藏品/元素收藏瓶/*

简介: 雷元素褪去狂暴，凝固成淡紫树枝状结晶，无电无扰、紫光微闪。绝缘涂层瓶与闪电凹槽盖锁住这份冷峻平衡，意外的稳定态使其成为珍稀收藏。
简介_EN: Lightning element calms from fury into pale purple branch-like crystals, glow faintly without disturbance. Insulated coated bottle with lightning-groove cap locks this cold balance. Accidental stability makes it a rare collectible.
icon: res://素材/豆包AI素材/药水/收藏品/元素收藏瓶/*

简介: 土元素聚为正方体岩石，密度均匀、摇晃不撞壁，无风化无磨损。厚重玻璃瓶与防滑金属盖封存这份沉稳平衡，意外造就的绝对稳定，是收藏界的质感珍品。
简介_EN: Earth element forms uniform-density cubic rock, no collision or wear when shaken. Thick glass bottle with non-slip metal cap preserves this steady balance. Accidental perfect stability makes it a premium textured collectible.
icon: res://素材/豆包AI素材/药水/收藏品/元素收藏瓶/*

简介: 冰元素凝为完美六边形冰晶，恒定低温却不冻伤瓶身、不融不结霜。防霜涂层瓶与金属盖锁住这份通透平衡，七彩折射下的稳定态，是极具美感的收藏佳物。
简介_EN: Ice element condenses into perfect hexagonal crystal, constant low temperature without freezing bottle or frosting. Anti-frost coated bottle with metal cap locks this transparent balance. Stable state with colorful refraction makes it an aesthetic collectible.
icon: res://素材/豆包AI素材/药水/收藏品/元素收藏瓶/*

简介: 激活熔岩裂变型副本，橙红岩浆状液体内含熔岩晶体，摇晃现金色火纹漩涡。
简介_EN: Activates Lava Fissure instance. Orange-red magma-like liquid with lava crystals, reveals golden fire vortex when shaken.

简介: 激活密林畸变型副本，墨绿色浆液含发光孢子，静置释放淡绿雾气，沾荧光苔藓。
简介_EN: Activates Twisted Forest instance. Dark green slurry with glowing spores, releases pale green mist when still, stained with fluorescent moss.

简介: 激活冰封破碎型副本，淡蓝色液体内含冰晶，瓶壁凝薄冰，摇晃有冰晶碰撞声。
简介_EN: Activates Frozen Wasteland instance. Pale blue liquid with ice crystals, thin ice forms on bottle wall, ice clinking sound when shaken.

简介: 激活沙暴侵蚀型副本，土黄色浑浊液混沙砾，摇晃形成沙暴漩涡，瓶壁留沙痕。
简介_EN: Activates Sandstorm instance. Yellow murky liquid mixed with gravel, forms sand vortex when shaken, sand marks left on bottle.

简介: 激活星际破碎型副本，深紫色液体内含星尘，静置成星系，摇晃现星云漩涡。
简介_EN: Activates Void Rift instance. Deep purple liquid with stardust, forms galaxy when still, nebula vortex when shaken.

简介: 激活机械失控型副本，银灰色液含齿轮虚影，摇晃发声，瓶壁印机械齿轮。
简介_EN: Activates Mechanism Rampage instance. Silver-gray liquid with gear phantoms, makes sound when shaken, mechanical gears printed on bottle.

简介: 激活深渊腐蚀型副本，墨黑液含紫色腐蚀纹，静置成漩涡，瓶壁沾黑色粘稠污渍。
简介_EN: Activates Abyss Corruption instance. Inky black liquid with purple corruption patterns, forms vortex when still, black sticky stain on bottle.

简介: 激活幻境迷踪型副本，七彩渐变液含微型棱镜，摇晃折射彩光，瓶壁现场景虚影。
简介_EN: Activates Illusion Maze instance. Colorful gradient liquid with tiny prisms, refracts colored light when shaken, scene phantoms on bottle.

简介: 炼金加热过度的产物，黑褐浓稠液含大量灰黑残渣，口感苦涩，摇晃时泛出浑浊黑雾。
简介_EN: Product of overheated alchemy. Black-brown thick liquid with massive gray-black residue, bitter taste, releases murky black fog when shaken.

简介: 材料配比失衡所致，灰白结块膏体粗糙多孔，接触皮肤易留难洗粉末，状貌杂乱。
简介_EN: Result of unbalanced material ratio. Gray-white clumpy paste, rough and porous, leaves hard-wash powder on skin.

简介: 材料反应失控的结果，墨黑浊液浮满易破泡沫，接触皮肤暂留黑痕，转瞬即逝。
简介_EN: Result of uncontrolled material reaction. Inky black turbid liquid covered in fragile foam, leaves temporary black mark on skin.

简介: 遗漏提纯步骤的产物，铅灰色浆液粘稠难咽，残留口腔留灰痕，渗漏易粘连瓶盖。
简介_EN: Product of skipped purification step. Lead-gray slurry, thick and hard to swallow, leaves gray trace in mouth, sticks to cap when leaked.

简介: 附魔环节失败所得，苍白液体内含雾粒，开盖释放白雾，无其余别样影响。
简介_EN: Result of failed enchanting. Pale liquid with mist particles, releases white fog on opening, no other effects.

简介: 研磨工艺粗糙造成，炭黑粉末结块严重，自带焦苦味，易沾染皮肤且难清洗。
简介_EN: Caused by rough grinding. Charcoal-black powder heavily clumped, burnt bitter taste, sticks to skin and hard to clean.

简介: 冷却工艺失当造就，暗灰结晶布满龟裂纹，触摸仅感微刺，静置偶有碎屑脱落。
简介_EN: Caused by improper cooling. Dark gray crystal full of cracks, slightly prickly to touch, occasional crumbs fall when still.

简介: 材料未融合的炼金产物，液分深浅两层，入口先苦后涩，摇晃后仍会快速分层。
简介_EN: Alchemy product of unmixed materials. Liquid separates into dark and light layers, bitter then astringent on tongue, quickly re-separates after shaking.

简介: 修复过程中意外留存的特殊存在，赛博朋克错误化瓢虫，静置于灰色封印溶液中。
简介_EN: Special existence preserved accidentally during repair. Cyberpunk-glitched ladybug resting in gray sealing solution.
